posts.title: USB-C PD Barrel Adapter
posts.description: I recently wanted to use my DE-5000 LCR meter, but the 9V battery that was inside had died. I then had to waste time going out to buy a 9V battery, as I didn’t have the right wall plug adapter. After I was done with it, I remembered Mike Harrison’s video on “USBCing all the things” and decided to do the same.
